input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale: A full-text search for "insurance" returns no results, and the miscellaneous provisions (Sections 13-30 in sec-12) contain no coverage requirement, so the agreement lacks any insurance obligation. TrueLink hosts our web site, Client Content and customer credit data and provides Support Services, which places the absence of coverage in walk-away territory under the rule (no insurance for a vendor processing personal data). We inserted a new Section 31 after Force Majeure (p0097) at the preferred position — CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O (including tech E&O) USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request — and flagged the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) in the comment. Note the survival clause (p0090) references "Sections 1 and 5 through 30"; a conforming update to that cross-reference can be handled administratively.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 31 requiring TrueLink to carry standard insurance (CGL, E&O and cyber) with certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The agreement has no insurance provision even though TrueLink hosts our web site and processes Client Content and customer data, so we have added our standard coverage requirement (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M) with certificates on request. If helpful, we can accept reduced limits of USD 1,000,000 E&O and USD 2,000,000 cyber.

ops.text: 31. INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance, including technology errors and omissions, of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. TrueLink shall provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
